title: Align /daemon landing + key pages with the new narrative (remove contradictions)
story: As a reader exploring the Kernel section, I want the Kernel pages to consistently describe DaemonCore as governance beneath orchestration (not 'the orchestration layer') so the site feels coherent and trustworthy.
description: Update /daemon/index, /daemon/why-different, /daemon/comparisons, and /daemon/overview (or replace legacy language) to align with the new narrative and versioned guarantees, removing contradictory copy.
acceptance_criteria: No page describes DaemonCore as an orchestrator or orchestration layer.
Comparisons page includes a simple 'Orchestrator vs DaemonCore' distinction with mechanisms examples.
Why-different page frames the missing layer as legitimacy/governance rather than coordination.
All pages include explicit V1 vs V1.5 language where relevant.
